description: Create layered collectible cards with 3D tilt, reactive foil lighting, and accessible interactions.

defaultPrompt: Create a holographic collectible card for my character.
Turn my artwork into a layered 3D card.
Add accessible tilt and flip to my React card.
interface.longDescription: Design and build interactive collectible cards from your characters, products, or artwork. Parallax Card guides separate background and transparent character artwork, readable live typography, pointer-reactive 3D depth, foil highlights, and optional flip and layer views. Includes adaptable React, CSS, and motion-hook templates with keyboard controls, reduced-motion support, and integration guidance. Use your own artwork or generate new art with an available image-generation tool. Artwork binaries are not included.

name: parallax-card
